Values below match the published 2025 guidelines to the best of build-time knowledge but MUST be re-verified against the Federal Register notice before launch. See VERIFICATION-NEEDED.md.
_verificationNote: AUDITED 2026-08-15 — ONE CORRECTION IDENTIFIED, not yet applied (awaiting review). Applies to: the 2025 HHS poverty guidelines, which are the ones COVERAGE YEAR 2026 must use. THE FILE NAME IS CORRECT BY DESIGN — do not 'upgrade' it to the 2026 guidelines. ACA eligibility for a coverage year uses the guidelines in effect at the start of that year's open-enrollment period, i.e. those published in the PRIOR calendar year: 2026 coverage uses the 2025 guidelines; 2027 coverage will use the 2026 guidelines (contiguous-48 $15,960 + $5,680, Alaska $19,950 + $7,100, Hawaii $18,360 + $6,530, published 15 Jan 2026) in a future fpl.2026.json. Verified against the Federal Register notice, 90 Fed. Reg. 5917 (Jan. 17, 2025), FR Doc. 2025-01377, fetched from https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-01-17/pdf/2025-01377.pdf on 2026-08-15. CORRECT: contiguous-48 $15,650 + $5,500; Alaska $19,550 + $6,880; Hawaii first person $17,990. CORRECTED 2026-08-15: HAWAII additionalPersonCents was 632500 ($6,325); the notice says 'add $6,330 for each additional person' and its printed table increments by exactly $6,330 (24,320 − 17,990; 30,650 − 24,320), so it is now 633000. The old value understated the Hawaii poverty line for every multi-person household, which understated the credit and overstated how close the household was to the cliff, compounding with family size. The placeholder Federal Register citation (bare federalregister.gov, bot-blocked) was replaced with the durable govinfo PDF URL for FR Doc. 2025-01377. WHERE TO RE-CHECK ANNUALLY: ASPE publishes mid-January at https://aspe.hhs.gov/topics/poverty-economic-mobility/poverty-guidelines ; take the citable version from the Federal Register notice on govinfo, not from federalregister.gov (bot-blocked). See VERIFICATION-STATUS.md.

citations.label: 90 Fed. Reg. 5917 (Jan. 17, 2025), FR Doc. 2025-01377 — Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines (the 2025 guidelines, which govern 2026 marketplace coverage)

note: Guidelines are linear in family size: fpl = firstPersonCents + (familySize − 1) × additionalPersonCents. All amounts are annual, in integer cents.
